subject: Missed demo — propose timebox + async options to keep pilot moving
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Missed demo — propose timebox + async options to keep pilot moving

Hi Sylvia —

Sorry we missed you on the call yesterday. We totally understand travel and last-minute exec priorities — want to keep momentum on the NovaCorp pilot without asking for another long block. Two quick recovery options: 

1) 20-minute timebox meeting: focused walk-through of the pilot plan and answers to any specific integration questions.
2) Async package: 10–12 minute recorded walkthrough + a one-pager MAP (attached) and a follow-up 15-minute Q&A only if needed.

If 1) works, here are three short time slots I have next week (all PT):
- Tue 2027-05-25 09:00–09:20
- Wed 2027-05-26 11:00–11:20
- Thu 2027-05-27 08:30–08:50

If you prefer the async option I can record a custom 10-min demo and send the MAP. Either way we can preserve the original pilot kickoff target without a long reschedule.

Attached: redwood-mutual-action-plan-6821.pdf (one-pager + suggested success metrics).

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(rachel@redwood.ai)

---
Attachment: redwood-mutual-action-plan-6821.pdf (1.2 MB PDF)
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@novacorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Cc: salesops@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-05-23T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed demo — propose timebox + async options to keep pilot moving

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the follow-up and the MAP. Apologies — our VP of Product was unexpectedly delayed in transit and ended up in back-to-back briefings. We definitely want to keep this moving; given the exec schedule next week the async package + a short Q&A sounds ideal. Can you send the recording by Monday 5/31? We can then book a 15-minute slot the following week if needed.

Also copying our ops mailbox to help coordinate any PO/contract questions.

Best,
Sylvia
Sylvia Park
Director, Product Ops — NovaCorp
(sylvia@novacorp.com)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaCorp — prioritize timebox vs async approach

Quick internal note (do not forward):

Sylvia pref'd async + a later 15-min Q&A. Our ask: include a brief section in the recording that covers entitlement/roles (they flagged compliance) and the expected infra footprint for a 1-seat pilot. Priyom — can you produce a 2-slide infra snapshot and a 30-second cost estimate we can overlay? Hannah — please prepare a short pre-baked invite text we can drop into salesops inbox to expedite scheduling for the Q&A.

Target delivery: recording + infra slides by EOD Mon 5/31. If we can get the recording out earlier it improves momentum.

Thanks —
Marcus
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, salesops@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-05-26T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed demo — propose timebox + async options to keep pilot moving

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks — we’ll go async first. Attached: short recorded walkthrough (link below), the MAP you already saw, and a two-slide infra summary from Priyom. I also included a quick calendar screenshot with the three 15-min Q&A buckets we can offer; pick one and I’ll confirm.

Recording link (private): https://drive.google.com/file/d/recording-novacorp-6821
Attached: calendar-screenshot.png, redwood-mutual-action-plan-6821.pdf, infra-summary-6821.pdf

Proposed 15-min Q&A slots (PT):
- Wed 2027-06-02 09:00–09:15
- Thu 2027-06-03 08:30–08:45
- Fri 2027-06-04 11:45–12:00

If none of those work we can also do a 20-minute timebox the week of 6/7.

Rachel
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia@novacorp.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, salesops@novacorp.com
Date: 2027-05-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed demo — propose timebox + async options to keep pilot moving

Hi all —

Thanks for the speedy turnaround — recording looks great and the infra slides answered our immediate questions. Let’s take the Wed 6/2 09:00–09:15 PT Q&A slot; I’ve asked salesops to send a calendar invite to the small group (myself + one engineer + procurement). Please include a short agenda: 1) infra/cost clarifications (5m) 2) pilot success metrics (5m) 3) next steps/PO (5m).

Appreciate the flexibility.

Sylvia

---
Thread summary (internal use): 1) Convert missed live demo into async delivery; 2) Deliver infra slides and MAP by 5/31; 3) Confirm 15-min Q&A Wed 6/2 09:00 PT; 4) Salesops to start PO conversation.
